environment.limits: Single uncontrolled desktop host; OS filesystem cache is not flushed. Cold means empty tool disk cache, not cold OS/page cache. No simultaneous benchmark suites. No production CDN, Next.js or serverless measurement.

protocol: Seven rotated/interleaved fresh-Node rounds per corpus, cold deletes all tool disk caches; immediate warm fresh-process repeat. Photographic: 24 pinned Kodak inputs. Synthetic: three deterministic 1200x800 fixtures. WebP q75, widths 288/384/480 produce integer heights. Explicit fit=inside, no preview, no inlining. Imageway q=75; competitors quality=75. Identical asset byte/SHA multisets across engines, rounds and cache states required. Native concurrency uses each tool defaults. buildMs starts before tool import and ends before asset verification; common Vite/Svelte imports outside timer for all engines. processWallMs includes setup/verification. OS cache unflushed, single uncontrolled desktop.
